```
['create a V0ChatConfig instance to configure OpenAI-compatible v0 API integration', 'get the v0 API base URL from environment variable or default to https://api.v0.dev/v1', 'retrieve the v0 API key from environment variable V0_API_KEY or passed argument', 'check which OpenAI parameters are supported by the v0 chat completions endpoint', 'configure the v0 custom LLM provider with api_base and api_key for chat completions']

```
